This category contains '''''official tools''''' created by [[BI|Bohemia Interactive]]. These tools are provided to the community under the terms that allows free use of the tools for any '''non commercial''' purposes. Any commercial use of the tools is <u>strictly prohibited</u> without permission from [[BI]]. 

If you want Bohemia Interactive's proprietary tools and technology for a commercial purposes (including but not limited to using it for military training) you're not allowed to use these tools.

You must agree to the terms of [[End User License Agreement for BI's Tools]] before using any of the tools.

The BI community have created some decent tools that have extended features not found in the [[BI]] tools. For a listing of community made tools see [[ArmA: Community Tools]].
